content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Today, you can set up a complete digital commerce infrastructure using free and robust tools. By leveraging platforms like GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for crypto transactions, you can launch your online store within 48 hours. This setup allows for instant payment processing in multiple cryptocurrencies, providing a seamless experience for both you and your customers. There’s no need to depend on traditional banking or payment services that often restrict access in Zimbabwe. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-start-selling-digital-products-crypto-everything-you-5|COREMERCH guide to start]] selling your digital products like ebooks, courses, or templates immediately and bypass the conventional barriers.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The minimum viable stack comprises essential tools designed to ensure quick deployment and operational efficiency. Use GitHub Pages for hosting your website, with NOWPayments integrated for crypto payment processing. The stack can be expanded to include Cloudflare Pages for enhanced performance and security. By implementing this stack, you can accept payments in USDT on the Tron network, which settles transactions in under 60 seconds for a fee of less than $0.10. This efficient framework empowers you to manage your sales independently, ensuring you maintain full ownership of your data and revenue.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on the steps that directly impact your ability to transact. Avoid getting bogged down by unnecessary integrations or features that can be considered later. For instance, prioritize setting up your payment processing and product delivery mechanisms over advanced marketing tools or analytics. By concentrating your efforts on the core components of your digital store, you can quickly adapt and adjust as your business grows. This pragmatic approach allows you to initiate sales and receive payments without delay, setting the stage for future enhancements.
Blockchain payments eliminate geographic barriers for digital creators.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To get your first transaction live, start by loading your digital products onto your website hosted on GitHub Pages. Next, integrate NOWPayments to enable seamless crypto transactions. Test the payment process using a small transaction to ensure everything functions correctly. Ensure your digital products are easily accessible for instant download upon payment confirmation. With this framework in place, you can confidently market your digital offerings knowing that you have a reliable payment solution ready for your customers.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, complete the setup of your digital store. Start by deploying your site on GitHub Pages and integrating NOWPayments for payment processing. Create product listings for at least three digital products, ensuring that they are ready for instant delivery. Conduct a test transaction to verify the payment process using USDT on Tron. Once your store is operational, promote it through social media channels to attract initial customers. By taking these steps, you will establish a functioning online marketplace that can scale with your needs.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
GitHub Pages offers free hosting, ensuring low overhead costs.

Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and other restricted markets searching for international payment solutions are looking for the same thing: a way to receive USD-equivalent payments from global buyers without a Stripe or PayPal account. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete answer — Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments deployed under your accounts in 48 hours. For creators who want to self-deploy, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 covers both stack options with full source code and step-by-step configuration guides. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Confirm which cryptocurrencies have the best P2P conversion options in your specific country before configuring your payment settings — USDT on Tron is a safe starting point for most African and South Asian markets. Create your NOWPayments account and add wallet addresses for your primary coins. Set up a P2P exchange account — Binance P2P is available in most restricted markets and supports local currency pairs. Deploy your chosen stack: Stack 01 via the Sovereign Blueprint or Stack 02 via the Edge Commerce Stack deployment. Configure the NOWPayments IPN webhook URL in your account settings pointing to your backend endpoint. Run a complete mainnet test transaction and confirm the pipeline end-to-end before promoting. Complete a test P2P conversion with a small amount so you know the process before your first real sale.
